mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MATCHING_TBL VALUES (SEQ_MATCH_NO.NEXTVAL, #{userNo}, #{matchingTitle}, #{matchingContent}, DEFAULT, NULL, DEFAULT, #{matchingLocation}, #{matchingDate}, #{matchingLevel}, #{matchingTime}, #{partnerType}, DEFAULT, #{matchingUserCount}, #{activityId}, #{matchingPrice})
mapper.select: SELECT ACTIVITY_NAME, ACTIVITY_ID, USE_YN FROM ACTIVITY_TBL WHERE WEIGHT_LEVEL = 1 AND USE_YN = 'Y'
SELECT ACTIVITY_NAME, ACTIVITY_ID, USE_YN FROM ACTIVITY_TBL WHERE ACTIVITY_NAME LIKE '%'||#{keyword}||'%' AND USE_YN = 'Y'

SELECT M.ACTIVITY_ID, M.MATCHING_NO, M.USER_NO, M.MATCHING_TITLE, M.MATCHING_CONTENT, M.CREATED_AT, M.UPDATED_AT, M.MATCHING_LOCATION, M.MATCHING_DATE, M.MATCHING_LEVEL, M.MATCHING_TIME, M.PARTNER_TYPE, M.MATCHING_TYPE, M.MATCHING_PRICE, M.MATCHING_USER_COUNT, A.ACTIVITY_NAME, U.USER_NICKNAME,
CASE WHEN TO_DATE(M.MATCHING_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') < TRUNC(SYSDATE) THEN '마감'
WHEN M.MATCHING_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AND M.MATCHING_TIME <= TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'HH24:MI') THEN '마감'
WHEN TO_DATE(M.MATCHING_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') - TRUNC(SYSDATE) BETWEEN 0 AND 2 THEN '마감임박'
ELSE '모집중' END AS MATCHING_STATUS
FROM MATCHING_TBL M JOIN ACTIVITY_TBL A ON M.ACTIVITY_ID = A.ACTIVITY_ID JOIN USER_TBL U ON M.USER_NO = U.USER_NO
WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y' AND M.DELETE_YN = 'N'
ORDER BY M.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM MATCHING_TBL ORDER BY CREATED_AT DESC
